kitDescription: Nihilister is a Fire sniper-rifle Attacker built around piercing fire: every fully-charged shot grants her Pierce and a wider piercing line for the following round, and any shot that strikes two or more enemies at once splashes bonus damage onto everything it hits. Her second skill is an automatic blast that periodically damages enemies in her attack range. Her burst hits enemies in range for instant damage, ignites them with a ten-second burn ticking every second, and doubles her own magazine from 6 to 12 rounds for fifteen seconds so she fires far longer between reloads. Against a single boss the multi-enemy splash and piercing radius never come into play, so her practical kit there is the pierce tag, the periodic blast, the burn, and the extended magazine.

skill1.driverSaid: shotFired → self gainPierce durationSec 4; shotFired IS the full-charge trigger (SR auto-full-charges every shot); '1 round' is round-count but gainPierce has no durationShots, so 4s wall-clock stand-in = worst-case inter-shot gap (reload 2.35s + charge cycle 1.37s ≈ 3.7s); ⚑1 with recipe; per-shot refresh keeps the tag continuous; pinned byte-identical to the static-flag form while firing
skill1.blindSaid: S6: identical encoding (shotFired → gainPierce) with durationSec 2 stand-in, also ⚑-flagged; S2b: hasPierce or per-shot gainPierce both damage-equivalent at scope, note must name the stand-in (driver's note does); S5: asserts effect-form not static flag, shot-keyed trigger, and damage-inertness without a Pierce Damage ▲ source
skill1.formulaCheck: SSOT §11: Pierce Damage ▲ is a DamageUp entry needing a Pierce tag; the tag itself is damage-inert without a consumer. Driver's own fixture injects the consumer (d-killer-wife's 13.55 pierceDamagePct to SR allies) so the tag is observable and load-bearing — exactly the isolation method III requires. Round→wall-clock is a documented approximation; driver pins it never lapses between rounds actually fired (byte-identity vs static flag under fixture cadence). First shot of the fight untagged (dispatch order) — documented, one-shot-per-fight effect, negligible.
skill1.explanation: Trigger identity, target, and effect kind match the prose and both blinds converged on them independently. The only divergence from the literal text is the round-count→4s conversion, which is schema-forced (no durationShots on gainPierce), documented as ⚑1 with a measurement recipe, and behaviorally pinned. The blind's 2s stand-in would under-cover across reloads; the driver's 4s is the better-argued estimate over the same unmeasured cadence tuple.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHA found: all 7 kit lines are FAITHFUL (5) or DOCUMENTED_GAP (2), with the two unmodeled lines carried verbatim, fenced against their named nearest-wrong misreads, and pinned inert by test. The blind re-derivations converged with the driver on every load-bearing decision — trigger kinds (shotFired / interval:10 / burstCast), targets, magnitudes, the sustained flavor, the flat-ammo primitive, and the exact unmodeled set — and the only deltas are cosmetic or strictly better-argued on the driver's side (S6's redundant explicit crit:true, behavior-identical; S6's gainPierce 2s stand-in vs the driver's reload-aware 4s, both ⚑ over the same unmeasured cadence tuple). S2b's one error is a stale 'DoT crit default-OFF' prior contradicted by the SSOT's DOT_CRIT-ON — a blind-side recon note, not a driver finding, and harmless because all parties shipped the identical no-opt-in dot. Discrimination holds: the S2 frame-set pin kills wrong cadences, the fullBurstEnter counterfactual observably moves the nuke, the collapsed-burn counterfactual differs, and where behavior genuinely cannot discriminate (maxAmmoPct 100 coincidence) the driver says so and carries the pin structurally instead of pretending. Residuals the owner should spot-check (same-model stability, not correctness): (1) the ⚑ set — SR cadence tuple feeding the 4s pierce stand-in and the S2 first-fire t=10 phase — against one focused-solo recording per the override's own recipes; (2) the S5 GREEN was produced through driver-applied mechanical adaptations (fixture swap to sole-B2 per S2b's own prescription, magnitude-keyed tick ID, the 2% teammate gauge-coupling bound) — all commented and intent-preserving on inspection, but the convergence signal is partially driver-mediated, so a spot re-run of the unmodified blind assertions on the two adapted fixtures is the cheap independent confirmation; (3) the d-killer-wife pierce feed that makes the tag observable assumes her pierceDamagePct gates on the pierce tag as the SSOT describes — verified in the driver's load-bearing test, but it is the single fixture coupling the whole N1 argument rests on.
